## What's new: dictation

- **Speak instead of typing.** Click any text field, such as a task title, a description, a memory or the search box. Then press the microphone in the bottom-right corner, or Ctrl+Shift+Space, and speak. Words appear in the field as you talk and get one final, more exact pass when you stop.
- **Many languages.** Choose the language in **Settings → General → Dictation language**. Automatic recognises the language you speak; picking a fixed language makes it about a second quicker.
- **Stays on your computer.** A speech model inside the app turns speech into text. Nothing is sent online, and the microphone is used only while you dictate. The Flatpak now has microphone access for this, and still has no network access.
- The download is larger than before, because it now includes the speech model.
